response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg FROM compliancecase), status_avgs AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_modelconf, o.overall_avg FROM status_avgs AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_modelconf > o.overall_avg), reference AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - q.overall_avg AS above_average_by, q.avg_modelconf / r.qualifying_avg AS ratio_to_qualifying_avg FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN reference AS r WHERE r.qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL
